craft_notes: Sthāyin: five openings. Rows: purposes then parts. Read aloud: inventory.

lines: Thus look without: first for giving up, or joining;
for taking, or for both, or by both-less-ness for self-nature rest —
there in order: breech, hand, foot, lap.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tathā hi bahis tāvat tyāgāya vā anusaṃdhiḥ ādānāya vā dvayāya vā ubhayarahitatvena svarūpaviśrāntaye vā tatra krameṇa pāyuḥ pāṇiḥ pāda upastha iti
